title: Course and academic year models with seed script
agent_directive: This JSON is the complete task spec. First read docs/prompts/_standards.json once, then load the skills in `skills`. Read only the `spec_sections` of docs/fypms-docs.md (grep the FR id; never open the whole file). Build only what `build` lists and reply with `reply_format` from _standards.json.
build: models/course and models/academic-year (schema, repo). Helpers: getCurrentAcademicYear(), getCourse(id), listCourses().
src/lib/teams/group-number.ts (pure): coursePrefix(courseId) -> BCS | BICT | HCS | HICT and formatGroupNumber(prefix, yearYY, seq) -> e.g. BICT26_01; unit-tested.

scripts/seed.ts --mode base|full (tsx) reading ONLY fixtures/ through fixtures/index.ts. Mode base writes: the four courses, one current academic year starting 2026, counters next_sequence 1, roster docs from fixture students (email = studentEmail(index), contact, course_id, user_uid null, signup_completed_at null), staff_whitelist docs from fixture staff. It creates NO Auth users and NO users docs. Mode full prints 'not available yet' until DEV-01

Seed is idempotent (set merge, deterministic ids), exits unless FIRESTORE_EMULATOR_HOST is set, and warns when the project id does not start with demo-. Remove the old SEED_COORDINATOR_EMAIL and SEED_YEAR logic

scripts/check-data.ts per fypms-test-data/references/fixtures-contract.md (base checks: roster and whitelist match the fixtures, no unknown records); npm scripts seed:base, seed:full, check:data and dev:fresh
assumptions: No UI for editing academic years in v1; deadlines are edited in seed data until a later phase
acceptance: After npm run dev:fresh the dev emulator has 4 courses, 1 academic year, 40 roster students and 6 staff entries, zero Auth users, and check:data passes
